question: The 'Vyas Samman', a literary award was first awarded in the year ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__1991__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Vyas Samman** 

 
 
• The Vyas Samman is **literary award first awarded in 1991.**
 
• This is awarded by **K.K Birla Foundation annually**.
 
• It includes **payout of 4 Lakhs from the recent 2019 distribution with plaque and citation**.
 
• In 1991, this was** awarded to Ram Vilas Sharma for his literary work "Bharat ke Pracheen Bhasha aur Hindi.".**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Prof. Sharad Pagare got this prestigious award in 2020 for his novel "Patliputra Ki Samragi".**
 
• **Eligibility for this award** is that the** literary work must be in Hindi language and must be published in the past 10 years.**
